If you see “Luxury vehicle non-deductible”, that's the luxury vehicle adjustment.

written.driveaway: If you see only “RemServ price”, its GST basis is unclear on the quote reviewed. Check the full on-road price before entering it.
written.residual: If “Residual value” has no GST label, choose “I'm not sure” unless the quote or provider confirms the basis.
written.payment: If “Finance” is per fortnight with no GST label, enter it per fortnight and choose “I'm not sure” for GST.
written.running: If you see “Servicing & Incidentals” as one line, enter that combined amount under servicing and leave tyres blank.

pointers.text: Look for “FBT Base Value” on the vehicle details page. Only have the summary? Multiply “GST savings on car” by 11, unless it's the maximum.
pointers.more: The maximum is $6,353. If yours is that, ask RemServ, or take the drive-away price and subtract stamp duty, rego and CTP.

pointers.text: If you see only “RemServ price”, its GST basis is unclear on the quote reviewed. Check the full on-road price before entering it.
Can’t find months deferred on your RemServ quote? Choose “Not sure” (we’ll assume 2) unless told otherwise.
Can’t find a documentation or establishment fee on your RemServ quote? Leave this at $0 unless yours lists one.
If “Residual value” has no GST label, choose “I'm not sure” unless the quote or provider confirms the basis.
If “Finance” is per fortnight with no GST label, enter it per fortnight and choose “I'm not sure” for GST.
If you see “Servicing & Incidentals” as one line, enter that combined amount under servicing and leave tyres blank.
Can’t find a management fee on your RemServ quote? Leave this at $0 unless yours lists one.

written.driveaway: “Vehicle Purchase Price” may omit on-road costs. Check it includes GST and all on-road charges before using it.
written.payment: If you see “Lease Payment (excl GST)” under “Annual Car Expenses”, it's a yearly total: choose “Per year (total)”.
written.defer: If you see “Number of Lease Payments: 59” on a 60-month term, that's a 1-month deferral.

pointers.text: Remunerator's summary has no fee line and says management fees are included in its figures. Leave this at $0 unless your quote lists one.

written.driveaway: Use “Vehicle Cost”, the line before “GST Credit” and “Financed Amount”. Check that it includes GST.
written.defer: Use “Months Deferred” as printed. If only “No. of Payments” appears, subtract it from the lease term in months.
written.payment: If you see “Total Lease Cost” under “Lease/Finance Budget (excluding gst)”, enter that figure excluding GST in the period shown.
written.running: If you see a “Contingency Budget” or “Car Washes/Incidentals”, check whether you want those budgets included in your comparison.
